And at 3:26 I'm going to convene here on February 20th of 2020 the Austin housing finance corporation 
meeting. We are in the city council chambers here at city hall, 301 west 2nd street, a quorum is present 
of the board. Do you want to take us through our consent agenda?  
>> Sure, Mandy, Austin housing finance corporation, you have three things today. First is approving the 
meeting minutes from December 5th and January 23rd. The second is approving and authorizing the 
negotiation of a loan agreement with blackshare neighborhood development corporation for $128,000 
for the rehabilitation of three affordable housing units. We have representatives of blacksheer here 
should you have any questions. And the third is authorizing the  
 
[3:27:50 PM] 
 
negotiation of the acquisition of property on pecan boulevard in district 6, nearly four acres, $4.2 million 
for a future affordable housing development. I offer the items on consent. Happy to answer any 
questions.  
>> Mayor Adler: We have one person signed up to speak on some of these items. Is Gus peña here? No? 
I think that was the only person that we had signed up to speak. That gets us up to the dais. Any 
discussion on the consent? Someone want to move adoption of the consent? Councilmember Renteria 
makes that motion, councilmember pool seconds it. Those in favor of the consent agenda please raise 
your hand. Unanimous on the dais. I think that's all our work today. Our meeting is adjourned at 3:28. 
Ahfc.
